entries.head: promql
entries.message: promql: %s must be lowered by lowerCountValues, not the generic aggregate path
entries.rationale: buildAggFunc has the sole direct caller lowerPlainAggregateOverInput. Its production callers are lowerAggregate, lowerCountOrGroupOverMixedExpHistogramSetOp, and lowerPlainAggOverMixedFloatArm. Parser-produced COUNT_VALUES is diverted before that shared kernel: lowerAggregate calls lowerCountValues, while lowerSubqueryOverAggregate dispatches it to lowerSubqueryOverCountValues. The direct mixed-or form is recognized by countValuesOverMixedExpHistogramSetOp and lowered by lowerCountValuesOverMixedExpHistogramSetOp; the nested/already-lowered mixed form is handled by lowerCountValues and requireMixedPlanPolicy, then lowerCountValuesOverPlan. The count/group caller admits only COUNT/GROUP; all callers of the mixed-float wrapper are constrained to SUM/AVG or the float-only aggregate family, including lowerSumOrAvgOverMixedPlan gated by expHistogramAggOpIsMergeable. Therefore no parser-producible path can pass COUNT_VALUES to buildAggFunc.

entries.head: promql
entries.message: promql: aggregation %s does not take a parameter
entries.rationale: buildAggFunc is called only by lowerPlainAggregateOverInput, whose production entry paths are lowerAggregate, lowerCountOrGroupOverMixedExpHistogramSetOp, and lowerPlainAggOverMixedFloatArm. The PromQL parser rejects parameters on SUM/COUNT/AVG/MIN/MAX/STDDEV/STDVAR before lowerAggregate. The countOrGroupOverMixedExpHistogramSetOp recognizer separately requires a nil parameter. The set-op SUM/AVG and float-only paths are admitted by sumOrAvgOverMixedExpHistogramSetOp and floatOnlyAggOverMixedExpHistogramSetOp, which likewise require nil for every op in this switch arm. The merged lowerSumOrAvgOverMixedPlan route is reached from lowerAggregate only after expHistogramAggOpIsMergeable admits SUM/AVG, so it retains the parser guarantee. No wire path can satisfy a.Param != nil here.

guard: case parser.SUM, parser.COUNT, parser.AVG, parser.MIN, parser.MAX, parser.STDDEV, parser.STDVAR of switch a.Op

entries.head: promql
entries.message: promql: group() does not take a parameter
entries.rationale: buildAggFunc is called only by lowerPlainAggregateOverInput. GROUP can reach that kernel through lowerAggregate, where the PromQL parser has already rejected a parameter, or through lowerCountOrGroupOverMixedExpHistogramSetOp after countOrGroupOverMixedExpHistogramSetOp has explicitly required a nil parameter. lowerPlainAggOverMixedFloatArm no longer carries count/group: its production callers admit only SUM/AVG or float-only reductions. In particular lowerSumOrAvgOverMixedPlan, the merged mixed-plan route, is reached only after expHistogramAggOpIsMergeable admits SUM/AVG and therefore can never pass GROUP. No wire path can satisfy a.Param != nil in this arm.

entries.head: promql
entries.message: promql: aggregation op %s is not yet supported
entries.rationale: buildAggFunc has the sole direct caller lowerPlainAggregateOverInput. Its production callers constrain every operation before this fallback: lowerAggregate diverts TOPK/BOTTOMK, LIMITK/LIMIT_RATIO, and COUNT_VALUES through lowerTopK, lowerLimitK, lowerLimitRatio, and lowerCountValues, while every remaining parser aggregation is covered by the switch above; lowerCountOrGroupOverMixedExpHistogramSetOp passes only COUNT/GROUP; and lowerPlainAggOverMixedFloatArm receives only SUM/AVG or MIN/MAX/STDDEV/STDVAR/QUANTILE. The merged lowerSumOrAvgOverMixedPlan route is additionally gated by expHistogramAggOpIsMergeable and therefore passes only SUM/AVG. This default protects future internal misuse or a newly introduced parser operation, not a current wire query.

guard: past exhaustive switch a.Op over [case parser.SUM, parser.COUNT, parser.AVG, parser.MIN, parser.MAX, parser.STDDEV, parser.STDVAR; case parser.GROUP; case parser.QUANTILE; case parser.COUNT_VALUES]
